checks.name: Web accessibility and message-action axe suite on installed Chrome
checks.command: cd clients/web && CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' npm run test:accessibility
observations: Coverage includes accessible names/roles in selected rendered states, keyboard focus and modal containment/restoration, profile tab keyboard navigation, responsive 200% text, reduced motion, stream/dialog states, admin states and selected axe checks.
The message-action axe fixture covers grouped, system, deleted and failed messages.
The shared workflow invokes this command through tools/ci/native/web.py; CI therefore includes the accessibility suite.

checks.name: Flutter scoped accessibility, semantics, keyboard, scaling and focus suite
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/admin_accessibility test/admin_media_widget_test.dart test/theme_tokens_test.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart test/confirmation_dialog_test.dart test/screen_setup/dialog_test.dart test/profile_screen_test.dart test/voice_connection_badge_test.dart test/voice_shortcut_preferences_test.dart test/features/voice/prejoin/header_status_test.dart
observations: Includes named/selected semantics for all seven admin tabs, keyboard activation/focus, dialog traversal, selected responsive and 2x text cases, contrast tokens, workspace controls and selected voice/stream states.

contrast.coverage_note: Sampled opaque tokens and selected rendered states only; not a whole-app or composited/translucent-state certification.

touch_targets.coverage_note: Automated evidence covers selected message actions and compact admin controls. WCAG 2.2 AA exceptions remain applicable; no claim is made that every rendered control was measured.

manual_acceptance.limitation: Widget and browser automation cannot confirm announcements or traversal through a real screen reader. Keep #301 open until the manual acceptance is performed and recorded; platform runtime scheduling is tracked with #303.

artifact_storage: All PNGs referenced here remain ignored local .out captures; only this manifest and code/docs changes are committed.

cross_browser_revalidation.focus_finding: The WebKit run exposed that closing a mobile drawer after click could leave focus on the main region. Navigation and members close now restore focus to their named header opener with preventScroll; search retains prior-focus behavior.
limitations: This adds browser-automated keyboard focus coverage only. No VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack or Narrator traversal was run.
Native Safari task smoke and physical device acceptance remain NOT_RUN under #303.
